correspondence.limit: Synthetic texture correspondence, NOT physical events or synthetic TTC

correspondence.support: central half of each spatial axis, displacement within radius2
correspondence.target: bilinear probability on known displacement, no TTC targets

runtime: Existing lossless8GiB sensor LRU, prefetch, pinned microbatches, CUDA capture
sampling: uniform with replacement; seed7 per stage
stage1: 2000 updates, encoder only in both arms; all readout parameters frozen. CORRESPONDENCE uses only latest P texture and known transforms, uniform rows; TTC-CONTROL uses real P2, original phase loss and global P masses. This isolates pretraining objective/input regime, not identical FLOPs.
stage2: 10000 full-model TTC updates each, same original C1 objective, P2 and masses. Start from respective stage1 weights, reset Adam/scheduler and all RNG to seed7 in BOTH arms; same sampling sequence. No optimizer state reset within a stage.
